title: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’
summary: A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.
llm_summary: The Federal Aviation Administration has ordered an emergency nationwide ground stop, halting all flights across the United States. The shutdown comes after a cascade of communication failures crippled several Air Route Traffic Control Centers, which coordinate the country’s airspace. The FAA says the “extraordinary circumstances” require the pause until the systems are back online.
